column1: # thoth resource manifest — the only place URLs live.
# kind:      smvar_vcf | smvar_bed | sv_vcf | sv_bed | strat_tar
# sha256:    of the file behind the published results. fetch_resource records
#            the sha256 of what arrived; a run fails if it differs from this
#            value. Empty = not pinned: the run records what arrived and says so.
# v5.0q/ sits directly under the sample directory: no NIST prefix, no
# Small variants and structural variants. GIAB publishes SV benchmarks for
# HG002 only, so SV calls for any other sample resolve to no truth set and are
# skipped with a note at parse time.
# Upstream names carry no version (genome-stratifications-<ref>@all.tar.gz in
# the vN directory); dest adds it so two releases cannot collide on disk.
# GRCh37 and CHM13v2.0 are fetched only once truth rows for that reference
# exist. The T2T token is CHM13 upstream and CHM13v2.0 here, the key
# config['references'] uses; extract_stratifications strips the tarball's own
# top-level directory rather than assuming the two agree.
